name: bronze_brand
purpose: Brand master from OLTP. Keeps the original brand record so product enrichment can be rebuilt at any time.
note: All original source columns are retained. Production metadata is appended; source business values are not cleaned in Bronze.

name: bronze_category
purpose: Product category hierarchy from OLTP. Preserves category relationships before standardisation and hierarchy enrichment.
note: All original source columns are retained. Production metadata is appended; source business values are not cleaned in Bronze.

name: bronze_warehouse
purpose: Warehouse master from OLTP. Provides raw fulfilment-centre data used later by inventory and shipment models.
note: All original source columns are retained. Production metadata is appended; source business values are not cleaned in Bronze.

name: bronze_customer
purpose: Core customer profile from OLTP. Keeps the original customer state for traceability and replay.
note: All original source columns are retained. Production metadata is appended; source business values are not cleaned in Bronze.

name: bronze_customer_address
purpose: Customer address records from OLTP. Allows Silver to select and standardise customer addresses without changing raw data.
note: All original source columns are retained. Production metadata is appended; source business values are not cleaned in Bronze.

name: bronze_product
purpose: Product master from OLTP. Keeps the structured product truth before joining variants and external catalogue data.
note: All original source columns are retained. Production metadata is appended; source business values are not cleaned in Bronze.

name: bronze_product_variant
purpose: Sellable product variants from OLTP. Provides the variant-level key used by orders, inventory and catalogue enrichment.
note: All original source columns are retained. Production metadata is appended; source business values are not cleaned in Bronze.

name: bronze_inventory_level
purpose: Warehouse-level inventory state. Captures stock quantities before consistency checks and available-stock derivation.
note: All original source columns are retained. Production metadata is appended; source business values are not cleaned in Bronze.

name: bronze_orders
purpose: Order header transactions. Preserves order totals, lifecycle codes and source timestamps for CDC and reconciliation.
note: All original source columns are retained. Production metadata is appended; source business values are not cleaned in Bronze.

name: bronze_order_item
purpose: Order line transactions. Provides the detailed sales grain used by Silver and Gold sales models.
note: All original source columns are retained. Production metadata is appended; source business values are not cleaned in Bronze.

name: bronze_payment
purpose: Payment attempts for orders. Retains retries and payment states for reconciliation and payment analytics.
note: All original source columns are retained. Production metadata is appended; source business values are not cleaned in Bronze.

name: bronze_shipment
purpose: Shipment transactions. Preserves delivery and carrier details before fulfilment metrics are derived.
note: All original source columns are retained. Production metadata is appended; source business values are not cleaned in Bronze.

name: bronze_product_catalog_feed
purpose: External or partner product catalogue JSON. Adds seller, listing, price and descriptive attributes without changing the OLTP product master.
note: File lineage and rescued data are retained so bad or evolving records can be traced and replayed.

name: bronze_customer_review_feed
purpose: Customer review JSON. Keeps text-heavy feedback and rating data in its original form before validation.
note: File lineage and rescued data are retained so bad or evolving records can be traced and replayed.

name: bronze_order_event_log
purpose: Append-style order event JSON. Preserves operational events used for order journey and SLA analysis.
note: File lineage and rescued data are retained so bad or evolving records can be traced and replayed.

name: silver_customer_profile
purpose: Trusted customer entity for analytics and downstream serving. Names, email, phone and location are standardised here, while critical failures are kept out of the trusted table.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per current customer profile | Built from: | bronze_customer + bronze_customer_address
note: Earlier project name: silver_dim_customer_profile. The dimensional words dim/fact are removed because true dimensional modelling is done in Gold.

name: silver_product_master
purpose: Conformed product entity that combines structured product data with the file-based catalogue feed. It gives downstream models one consistent product view.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per product variant and selected catalogue listing | Built from: | bronze_product + bronze_product_variant + bronze_brand + bronze_category + bronze_product_catalog_feed
note: Earlier project name: silver_dim_product_master. The dimensional words dim/fact are removed because true dimensional modelling is done in Gold.

name: silver_order_line
purpose: Core transaction-conformed table for sales analytics. The grain is protected so multiple payments, shipments or events cannot accidentally multiply sales amounts.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | Exactly one row per order_item_id | Built from: | bronze_orders + bronze_order_item + selected payment/shipment context + product references
note: Earlier project name: silver_fact_order_line_enriched. The dimensional words dim/fact are removed because true dimensional modelling is done in Gold.

name: silver_inventory_snapshot
purpose: Validated stock view. available_qty is derived only after inventory consistency checks.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per warehouse + product variant + inventory state time | Built from: | bronze_inventory_level + bronze_warehouse + product references

name: silver_customer_review
purpose: Curated customer feedback with valid rating ranges and trusted business references. Event-style history is preserved rather than overwritten.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per review_id | Built from: | bronze_customer_review_feed + customer/order/product references
note: Earlier project name: silver_customer_review_curated. The dimensional words dim/fact are removed because true dimensional modelling is done in Gold.

name: silver_order_event
purpose: Curated order lifecycle event stream for operational analysis, SLA measurement and troubleshooting.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per event_id | Built from: | bronze_order_event_log + order/customer/payment/shipment references
note: Earlier project name: silver_order_event_curated. The dimensional words dim/fact are removed because true dimensional modelling is done in Gold.

name: silver_data_quality_audit
purpose: Stores data-quality results separately from business data so pipeline health and business-data quality can be monitored independently.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per DQ rule execution per table per run | Built from: | DQ checks across Bronze-to-Silver processing

name: gold.dim_customer
purpose: Historical customer dimension. Surrogate keys protect historical facts when customer profile values change.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per customer version

name: gold.dim_product
purpose: Analytics-ready product dimension. History is kept only for attributes that matter to historical reporting.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per product variant version

name: gold.dim_warehouse
kind: Type 1 / reference-style unless history is required
purpose: Conformed fulfilment location used by sales and inventory facts.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per warehouse

name: gold.dim_date
purpose: One reusable calendar definition for order, payment, shipment, delivery, review and event reporting.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per calendar date

name: gold.dim_payment_method
purpose: Small conformed reference dimension for payment reporting.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per payment method code

name: gold.dim_order_status
purpose: Standard order lifecycle values used consistently by facts and dashboards.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per order status code

name: gold.dim_channel
purpose: Conformed sales channel reference for website, mobile app, call centre or other channels.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per order channel code

name: gold.fact_sales_order_item
purpose: Canonical sales fact. All downstream sales metrics should start from this consistent grain and measure definition.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per order item

name: gold.fact_inventory_snapshot
purpose: Inventory snapshot fact. Quantities are additive across products and warehouses but should not normally be summed across dates.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per snapshot date + warehouse + product

name: gold.fact_customer_review
purpose: Review fact for customer satisfaction and product-quality analysis.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per review

name: gold.fact_order_event
purpose: Event fact for order journey, operational milestones and SLA reporting.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per order event

name: gold.ecommerce_sales_obt
purpose: Convenience model for wide analytical queries. One-to-many sources such as reviews, payments and events are reduced before joining so the sales grain is never duplicated.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | Exactly one row per order_item_id | Built from: | Canonical Gold dimensions/facts plus pre-aggregated review/fulfilment context

name: gold.mart_daily_sales
purpose: Daily sales KPI mart for dashboards and trend analysis.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per sales_date
note: Earlier/source name: gold_daily_sales_summary

name: gold.mart_product_performance
purpose: Combines sales and review measures for product performance reporting.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per sales_date + product_variant_id
note: Earlier/source name: gold_product_performance_summary

name: gold.mart_customer_360
purpose: Compact customer-level summary for segmentation, CRM-style analysis and dashboards.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per customer_id
note: Earlier/source name: gold_customer_360_summary

name: gold.mart_order_fulfillment
purpose: Order-level fulfilment mart for delivery performance and SLA monitoring.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per order_id
note: Earlier/source name: gold_order_fulfillment_summary

name: gold.mart_inventory
purpose: Fast inventory reporting without repeatedly aggregating the full snapshot fact.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per snapshot_date + warehouse_id + product_variant_id
note: Additional production mart added to complete inventory/review serving needs.

name: gold.mart_customer_review
purpose: Daily review and sentiment summary for product and customer-experience reporting.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per review_date + product_variant_id
note: Additional production mart added to complete inventory/review serving needs.

name: gold.mart_data_quality
purpose: Business-friendly quality summary showing whether trusted data remains complete, valid and fresh.
grain_and_dependencies: Grain: | One row per run_date + table_name + rule_category
note: Earlier/source name: gold_data_quality_summary
